units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:1:6">Y. Yeb. VIII, 8ᵈ</cite> top <he>על מנת למוֹהֲלָן</he> with the condition that he will circumcise them.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:1:6">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>את מוֹהֲלוֹ בע״כ</he> thou must circumcise him (the slave) even against his will.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:12">Cant. R. to I, 12</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מָהוּל</he>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 71a">Ib.</cite> <he>נולד</he> (<he>כשהוא</he>) <he>מ׳</he> born without a prepuce; a. fr.
